self_assessment: Added src/api/main/OperationProgressTracker.ts with the OperationId alias, the ExposedOperationProgressTracker pick of onProgress, and the OperationProgressTracker class - registerOperation() returns {id, progress stream, done} and done() both unregisters and ends the stream, while onProgress(operation, value) pushes 0-100 into just that operation's stream, so concurrent imports no longer share the global progress channel. Wired it into MainLocator, exposed it on MainInterface and through WorkerClient's exposeLocal facade, and passed mainInterface.operationProgressTracker into CalendarFacade in WorkerLocator. CalendarFacade._saveCalendarEvents now takes (eventsWrapper, onProgress: (percent: number) => Promise<void>) and reports 10/33/incremental/100 through it instead of worker.sendProgress; saveImportedCalendarEvents takes an OperationId and binds onProgress to that operation; the single-event saveCalendarEvent path passes a no-op. CalendarImporterDialog registers an operation, passes its stream to showProgressDialog and calls done() in .finally so the dialog is cleaned up on both success and error (replacing showWorkerProgressDialog). Removed the now-orphaned WorkerImpl dependency from CalendarFacade. Verified per-file with tsc: the only errors are missing-node_modules and ambient-global artifacts (Id, env, MainRequestType), none on the new symbols. Jest/ospec could not run - the proxy blocks codeload.github.com so deps cannot be installed.
